rules.citation: Texas: CMS Market Rating Reforms, individual-market Texas row (current table updated 2021-12-10); State Specific Age Curve Variations effective 2018 (federal default age curve); 45 CFR 147.102(c)(1), (d), (e), current through 2026-11-05; reviewed for PY2026 on 2026-11-07; retrieved 2026-11-07.
rules.note: Use the filed per-age/area/date/tobacco cents directly; never synthesize a rate from a curve. Family Option and populated family tiers remain unsupported. Individual medical only; no authorization for dental or SHOP.

notes: Compatibility bootstrap for the existing no-file command: TX individual medical PY2026 only.
For publication-wide rules explicitly ingest data/rating-rules/2026.json or 2027.json. Loading this bootstrap replaces the active 2026 rule set with TX only.
NY/VT and every absent state remain unsupported; never infer support from rate-row shape.
